---
title: "Step 1 - Training and Validation Data"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

## **Global**

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

Data     <- read_csv("project_traindata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
TestData <- read_csv("project_testdata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

CategoricalVars <- c("make", "segment", "transmission", "fuel_type", "province",
                     "service_history", "accident_history", "seller_type", "colour")

DropVars <- c("model_year")

CompareVars <- c("segment", "make", "transmission", "fuel_type", "service_history")

TrainShare <- 0.80

ShowChecks <- TRUE   # FALSE for the final report: hides the working checks
```

## **Preparing the Data**

#### 1.Categorical variables as factors

```{r}
Data <- Data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CategoricalVars), ~ fct_infreq(factor(.x))))
```

```{r, include=ShowChecks}
tibble(
  Variable = CategoricalVars,
  Levels   = sapply(Data[CategoricalVars], nlevels),
  Baseline = sapply(Data[CategoricalVars], function(x) levels(x)[1])
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Levels and baseline (most common) category per variable")
```

#### 2.Removed variables

```{r}
ModelData <- Data %>%
  select(-all_of(DropVars))
```

## **Random Split**

#### 3.Training and validation sets

```{r}
set.seed(244)

n <- nrow(ModelData)
TrainRows <- sample(1:n, size = floor(TrainShare * n), replace = FALSE)

TrainingData   <- ModelData[TrainRows, ]
ValidationData <- ModelData[-TrainRows, ]
```

#### 4.Checking the split

```{r}
unseen_levels <- function(NewData) {
  sum(sapply(CategoricalVars, function(v)
    length(setdiff(unique(as.character(NewData[[v]])),
                   unique(as.character(TrainingData[[v]]))))))
}

stopifnot(
  nrow(TrainingData) + nrow(ValidationData) == n,
  length(intersect(TrainingData$listing_id, ValidationData$listing_id)) == 0,
  unseen_levels(ValidationData) == 0,
  unseen_levels(TestData) == 0
)

TrainingData   <- TrainingData %>% select(-listing_id)
ValidationData <- ValidationData %>% select(-listing_id)
```

## **Comparing the Two Sets**

#### 5.Summary of both sets

```{r}
SplitData <- bind_rows(Training = TrainingData,
                       Validation = ValidationData, .id = "Set")

SegmentShare <- SplitData %>%
  count(Set, segment) %>%
  group_by(Set) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = segment, values_from = Percent)

SplitData %>%
  group_by(Set) %>%
  summarise(
    Rows = n(),
    Columns = ncol(TrainingData),
    Median_price = median(price),
    Mean_price = round(mean(price), 0),
    SD_price = round(sd(price), 0),
    Median_age = median(vehicle_age),
    Median_km = median(mileage)
  ) %>%
  left_join(SegmentShare, by = "Set") %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
        caption = "Training and validation sets (segment columns in %)")
```

#### 6.Working checks

```{r, include=FALSE}
split_prop_table <- function(var) {
  SplitData %>%
    count(Set, .data[[var]]) %>%
    group_by(Set) %>%
    mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-n) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Set, values_from = Percent, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(Difference = Training - Validation) %>%
    rename(Category = 1) %>%
    kable(caption = paste("Percentage of each set by", var))
}
```

```{r, include=ShowChecks, results="asis"}
for (v in CompareVars) {
  print(split_prop_table(v))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r, include=ShowChecks}
ggplot(SplitData, aes(x = price, fill = Set)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ Set, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of price per set", x = "price", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(SplitData, aes(x = Set, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 2.5, colour = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "price by set", x = "Set", y = "price") +
  theme_minimal()
```
